prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A few **well-known kid-friendly martial arts schools in St. Peters, MO** include **All Star Karate**, **Gracie Barra St. Peters**, **ATA Martial Arts – St. Peters**, and **World Martial Arts Academy**.[3][1][4][5]

If you want the *best fit* for kids, these stand out for different reasons:

- **All Star Karate** — offers kids karate programs and a free introductory program, which is useful if you want to try a class first.[6][7]
- **Gracie Barra St. Peters** — focuses on kids’ martial arts/Brazilian jiu-jitsu and markets itself as home to some of the area’s best kids’ martial arts.[1][7]
- **ATA Martial Arts – St. Peters** — a dedicated martial arts school with a St. Peters location and a public school page.[4][8]
- **World Martial Arts Academy** — offers youth Jiu Jitsu for ages 6–12 plus preschool karate and kids karate programs.[7][12]

A good way to choose is to visit the school, check the instructors’ reputation, confirm the class level fits your child, and try a free intro class if offered.[2] If you want, I can also narrow these down by **age**, **discipline** (karate vs. jiu-jitsu), or **best value**.
